request.title: Customer service GenAI assistant
request.description: A chatbot on the public website answers product and billing questions by retrieving from internal knowledge articles, and hands off to a human agent when confidence is low. It looks up the customer's open cases in a third-party CRM after the customer signs in. Conversation transcripts are stored for 90 days for quality review. We plan to use Amazon Bedrock for the model and want to launch in one region.
request.business_objective: Reduce call-center volume by 20 percent and improve first-contact resolution.

request.title: Partner payments status API
request.description: A public API lets partner firms submit payment instructions and query settlement status. Requests are validated and placed on a queue; a processor writes to a relational database and publishes events. Partners authenticate with API keys today. Operations wants the lowest-cost single-region design, but the business requires 99.99 percent availability. A nightly file from one partner still arrives over FTP.
request.business_objective: Give partners real-time settlement visibility and retire manual status emails.

request.title: Engineering events portal
request.description: An internal web portal where employees browse upcoming engineering talks and register to attend. Stores talk titles, speaker names, and registration counts. No customer data. Single-page app with a small API.
request.business_objective: Replace a shared spreadsheet and email threads for event sign-ups.
